digest.component_or_area: review-bot code review decision and voter
propositions: A transient GitHub git fetch hang times out after 300s and is converted to SnapshotFetchError, which the adapter's blanket exception handler misclassifies as a review conclusion instead of retryable infrastructure fault
The adapter returns BLOCK decision on infrastructure faults, causing the voter to POST a durable LLM-Review -1 vote and write a dedup row that suppresses backfill re-eligibility
The backfill reconciler pre-filters on has_llm_review_vote and already_voted, so a spurious -1 removes a change from retry recovery permanently even though re-review on the same code yields +1

A retryable infrastructure fault (SnapshotFetchError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, TimeoutError, ConnectionError) must be distinguished from genuine review conclusions and return ABSTAIN with no vote and no dedup row
An abstained change must remain vote-less so backfill re-picks it on the next pass, while genuine blocking findings and non-retryable exceptions must still post -1 fail-closed
